'''Giseppie Sterelie''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2001 Sydney tournament]] on 18 November 2001 with TRM (card for card Hunter's deck), according to Jason Baretta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3105">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-18-sydney-18-11-01d3105/ sydney-18-11-01], DeckTech (jason "zwitter" baretta, 18 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-18-sydney-18-11-01d3105/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
